# T6.2 (TASKS.md) -- DESIGN.md §3 degenerate-case table, row "Config change
# removes heir": the announced heir is voted out of the cluster; the very
# next heartbeat's eligibility re-check catches that it's no longer a
# voter (gate 1: "Voter (not learner), not the leader itself") and replaces
# it immediately -- the "or heir becomes ineligible" bypass in selectHeir
# means this doesn't wait on the hysteresis margin or minimum tenure at
# all, unlike an ordinary score-driven heir change.
#
# 4 voters, so removing one still leaves a proper 3-voter majority
# (1,3,4) behind -- no awkward 2-voter edge cases to reason about.

log-level error
----
ok

add-nodes 1 voters=(1,2,3,4) index=2 heir-election=true stability-score=50
----
ok
